name: Prince Edward Island
short: PEI's provincial heat pump rebate ended on April 15, 2026, and applications for free heat pumps are closed, so the open money is for insulation. Homeowners with household income under $55,000 can apply for free insulation, and everyone else can get rebates for insulation, windows and air sealing after a $99 energy audit. If you bought a heat pump between April 15, 2025 and April 15, 2026, you can still apply for that rebate within a year of buying it.

rows.rules: Bought one between April 15, 2025 and April 15, 2026? Apply within a year of buying.
